svg.title: Network activity along an independent control transect

cc:Work.dc:title: Network activity along an independent control transect
cc:Work.dc:description: Four vertically aligned panels plot all retained x3 maxima, detected peak period, finite-time Lyapunov exponent and three neuron activation standard deviations against gamma. Zero period means no short period detected. Each point uses the same initial condition, independently of the two-dimensional continuation maps.
